purpose: Diagnose whether continuous RSSM history prevents correction by a real current observation after execution failure; retain useful-memory regressions
scope: Existing old_band10+gap10 A/B roots only; 60 branches,240 transitions; two original joint seeds; no train/C/D samples

conditions.reset: At each real boundary, same cached four-frame two-camera E window, call model.initial(E_current); deterministic h reset to zero, sampled z from same posterior network. Earlier recurrent memory removed; window information retained. Each boundary reset is independent; it does not alter the continuous trajectory at subsequent observed boundaries.

sampling: 8 samples,original RNG81831,batch4,BF16,matmul high. Capture RNG before each original posterior draw, reuse exact GPU RNG state for reset; common random numbers, not forced identical categories under different distributions. Original next-step transition RNG reused for both conditions. Root free rollout uses original saved transition RNGs; suffix rollout uses shared prespecified seed91831+100000*model_seed+10000*split_index+100*batch_offset+10*origin+target. Restore global RNG after comparisons.
alignment: Before inference audit public input paths, final public vs final window frame, control-step indices vs private trace robot states, label positions vs endpoint info, feature-cache robot and E label indexing. No per-frame wall-clock timestamp exists: report this limitation and verify simulator control ordering rather than invent times. Zero-control refusals legitimately retain the previous window.
fresh_pixel_check: Re-encode the5 windows of B_coverage_gap_04_b0 with frozen DINO and verify raw feature cache exact; then reproduce global E for the original4-episode batch containing that branch for both frozen spatial models. No new fitting.
baseline_parity: Continuous current,one_step,wrong_action,persistence and free1..4 must reproduce previous replay arrays exactly before interpreting results.
metrics: Current relation exact for held identity/InDrawer/drawer, root-paired corrections and regressions, extra positives; immediate-after-executed-failure subset and later-after-first-failure subset separately; retention on known already-correct held/InDrawer states and visibility strata. One-step forecasts and anchored open-loop suffix forecasts separated from after-observation correction.
future_observation_rule: Root free1..4 preserved. Suffix prediction starts only at a real boundary and then imagines all remaining actions without reading any later E. Never aggregate re-observed states as a free rollout.
prior_reference: Retain native action prior before absorbing current E; observe keeps deterministic h and updates z. Natural prior sampling is the original stream. Reset changes h and conditional z together; cannot uniquely localize a module.
labels: Private labels only audit/scoring; independent object heads are references, never GT and not inputs to this diagnostic.
interpretation: Reset changes hidden-state distribution and removes useful memory; diagnostic, not deployment or a proof of root cause. Do not claim post-failure correction predicts failure beforehand.
